title: ACT vs SmolVLA: Imitation Learning for Manipulation
description: Teaching a simulated Franka Panda arm to pick and place objects, benchmarking a compact transformer policy (ACT, 52M) against a fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action foundation model (SmolVLA, 450M) using LeRobot in MuJoCo.

stats.label: Success Rate
stats.detail: SmolVLA (450M) vs 50% ACT on multi-stage pick-and-place · 50 fixed evaluation seeds

extraText: Engineered an end-to-end imitation learning pipeline: scripted expert demonstrations (500 episodes) → policy training → rigorous evaluation on 50 fixed seeds with 95% Wilson confidence intervals.

Built a custom randomized pick-and-place environment in MuJoCo (Franka Panda) with dual-camera inputs (front & wrist at 128×128) and strict multi-step success verification (placement, release, and back-off).

Demonstrated that while both policies achieve 94% on simple picking, the 450M VLA scales significantly better on complex multi-stage tasks (80% vs 50%), resolving critical post-grasp stalling failure modes observed in ACT.
